title: Franklin Electric Acquires Cat Pumps
body_markdown:
Franklin Electric Energy Systems, adds Cat Pumps as the leading brand in a newly created Industrial Uptime solution.


### About Cat Pumps


Cat Pumps is an industry-leading, premium brand relied upon by thousands of customers across a diverse range of mission-critical end markets. Based in Minneapolis with global operations, the company is a market leader in high-pressure plunger and piston pumps serving commercial and industrial applications.


Cat Pumps is known for best-in-class quality, product breadth, and customer support, and its products are found wherever high-pressure systems are in use for demanding applications: industrial cleaning, reverse osmosis and water treatment, vehicle cleaning, energy, specialty vehicles, and other commercial and industrial markets.


[Visit the Cat Pumps Website to learn more.](https://www.catpumps.com/)


### New Energy Systems Solution: Industrial Uptime


As part of Franklin Electric’s Energy Systems segment, Cat Pumps will be the leading brand of the new Industrial Uptime solution, delivering high-pressure pumping solutions and accessories for demanding commercial and industrial applications. Energy Systems continues to serve mission-critical applications where uptime expectations are stringent and reliability is non-negotiable. Cat Pumps extends that same reliability proposition into high-pressure pumping applications the segment previously did not serve.


### What This Means for Our Customers


Energy Systems builds on a foundation of delivering infrastructure and monitoring solutions for mission-critical applications that demand uncompromising uptime, safety, and reliability. The addition of Industrial Uptime moves the segment toward a broader, application-based portfolio organized around uptime and reliability. It expands participation in infrastructure-driven markets and strengthens differentiated capabilities in proven reliability, durability, safety, and lifecycle performance.
